description: The cheapest one-way fare seen on each day of the next three months or so from one city to another in Europe or Southeast Asia (non-stop flights), or on a long flight between a big airport outside the region and one of its cities (any stops): each day's price, its age and airline (and, when known, when the flight leaves and lands, local time), the cheapest by month, the airlines with how many days they fly it and their cabin bag rule, the cheapest the other way, and a link to the route's page on faredice.com.

from.description: A city by name ("Berlin", "Krakow", "Saigon") or IATA city code ("BER"). For a long flight, one end can be a big airport outside the region we have fares from (Vancouver, Toronto, New York, Sydney, London for Southeast Asia ...).

month.description: Only this month's days: YYYY-MM or a month's name ("november"). Default every day we have.

region.description: europe or southeast-asia. Default: the first region where both places are found, Europe first.

to.description: A city by name ("Berlin", "Krakow", "Saigon") or IATA city code ("BER"). For a long flight, one end can be a big airport outside the region we have fares from (Vancouver, Toronto, New York, Sydney, London for Southeast Asia ...).

name: nonstop_fares
title: Cheapest fare each day between two cities
